goal: CutDeck Transform anchor presets on a text Graphic snap to Premiere's blue text box corner (the box its Properties panel aligns by), falling back to the measured letters with a stated reason when the box can't be trusted

criteria.statement: Diagnosis: the anchor lands on the ink box; Premiere's box rule (1 em tall, centred capHeight/2 above baseline, x 0..shaped advance) is recorded from live native Align on two sizes
Helper predicts the box and ink per text layer from the newest save + font, matching the live-measured edges within 0.01 px, and gives a reason for unproven cases
Panel anchors to the box corner (through Motion, Vector Motion and the layer's own scale) when the predicted letters match the measured ones, else keeps the letters' corner with a note
No regressions: every CutDeck panel test (incl. Adobe API check) and the helper/prproj Python tests pass

command: import sys; t=open('docs/PREMIERE_FACTS.md',encoding='utf-8').read(); sys.exit(0 if 'capHeight / 2' in t and '-120.817' in t else 1)
